original_approval.design_response: Test each reachable branch with its actual ancillary state and basis paths. Compare the weaker condition on a particular coherent preparation and the stronger condition on every lawful input. Require the original target state to survive and test either half of a synchronized offer on its own.
original_approval.strongest_objection: A lawful earlier result can narrow the possible remote words. Testing a later offer on an unreachable word could manufacture an impossibility.
